hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */src/data/decks.json|*/src/data/generated.json|*/public/decks/*|*/public/decks-search.json|*/public/pdfjs/*) echo "生成物なので直接編集しない。decks/ か scripts/build-decks.mjs / scripts/fetch-content.mjs を直して npm run decks か npm run fetch:content で作り直す" >&2; exit 2;; esac
hooks.statusMessage: 生成物への編集を確認

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(npm run --silent typecheck 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -30 >&2; exit 2; };; esac
